title: loctree.anchors.v1
description: Frozen contract for the loctree anchor catalog (substrate-makieta v4, C0-01 freezes the SCHEMA; the real producer is L0-01: `loct anchors --format json`). Anchors give attribution (A1-01) stable, snapshot-aligned targets: anchor_id survives renames via the aliases history. anchor_catalog_revision from this catalog is embedded into loctree.overlay.intent.v1 documents.

schema.description: Optional self-describing schema tag for dispatch by consumers.

repo_id.description: Repository identity, org/repo or bare slug. Never an absolute filesystem path.

snapshot_commit.description: Loctree snapshot commit the catalog was emitted from (7-40 hex).

anchor_catalog_revision.description: Deterministic revision of this catalog: acr1:<sha256-hex> over the canonical serialization of all anchors + producer version.

producer_version.description: Version of the emitting loctree binary (L0-01).

anchorId.description: Stable anchor identity: anc1:<hex>. Deterministic emission is L0-01's obligation; the id survives renames (rename history lives in aliases).

relativePath.description: Repo-relative normalized path. Never absolute, never escaping the repo root.

qualifiedSymbol.description: Fully qualified symbol in the target language's canonical notation. No path separators.

alias.description: One rename-history entry: a previous path or previous qualified symbol this anchor was known under.

anchor.description: One anchor. Path-level anchors omit qualified_symbol/signature_hash; symbol-level anchors carry both.

signature_hash.description: Symbol signature hash: sig1:<hex>. Requires qualified_symbol.
